contexts.text: Bees know how to build cells, to suck honey out of flowers, etc. AC 6323:2. HH 108. DLW 355. CL 419. TCR 12:7. AE 1198:4.
Their knowledges and affections are connate, as with bees.
The bee in the land of Assyria () = falsity perverting the reasonings of the mind.
The bee in the land of Assyria = the falsity of reasoning thence derived.
Does the bee think in its little head...
That the ground is as a common mother... may be illustrated by this fact in connexion with bees...
The Internal of a bee is that from which its External is impelled to suck honey from the flowers...

By the bee in the land of Assyria, is signified false reasonings thence derived... As the Rational obtains everything that belongs to it from the scientifics of the natural man, its reasonings are signified by bees, because bees suck out and obtain their store from flowers, as the Rational does from the scientifics of the natural man. But here, by bees are signified false reasonings, because the Rational gathers what belongs to it from scientifics falsely applied. The reason such things are likened to flies and bees, is from correspondence, for various kinds of flying things appear in the World of Spirits, but they are appearances from the ideas of the thoughts of Spirits, and hurtful flying things among them are flies and bees of such a kind.

(Samson) tore the lion, and afterwards found in its carcase a swarm of bees, and honey () = that, after that faith (alone) had been dissipated, there succeeded, in the place of it, the good of charity.
